plan_item: 77.44.7.A — responsive hover/focus-visible lifecycle for all ten state fields across PARTIAL types
finding: All ten STATE_PROPERTY_IDS had tablet cross-type automation, but mobile-specific overrides were only represented in a narrow fixture. The public hover assertion also needed to clear a retained focus-visible target before measuring hover CSS.
change: Extended tests/browser/editor-inspector-tablet-state-partial-types.test.js so all ten state properties are edited on every editable PARTIAL type in both tablet and mobile hover/focus-visible modes. The mobile path verifies Canvas, draft Page Model, Save/reload, separate Publish, public rendering, and desktop/tablet isolation. Hover assertions blur a previously focused element; mobile shadow values use only the Registry's allowed presets. No runtime code changed.
coverage: 44 editable PARTIAL types; all ten state fields color, backgroundColor, backgroundImage, borderColor, boxShadow, opacity, textDecoration, fontWeight, rotate, and scale; tablet and mobile hover/focus-visible; exact states.set command/key routing; typed Inspector controls and rotate unit behavior; Canvas/public computed CSS; draft Save does not publish; reload restores values; separate Publish applies mobile; desktop remains independent; reset tablet values remain unset when mobile overrides publish; mobile-only focusable public output remains keyboard-safe. The pre-existing tablet path also verifies per-field reset, reset Save versus Publish, and Undo/Redo.

browser.result: PASS, 1/1 complete real Chromium test covering the connected tablet and mobile lifecycle; 1164.612 seconds.

The next integrated run exposed that the prior focus-visible target stayed focused during a hover assertion; the test now blurs it before hover measurement. The final full run passed.
